recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic trio portrait set against a bright, overcast coastal dune landscape. A central female figure in a voluminous black gown anchors the composition, flanked by two men in formal attire. The scene uses a desaturated, high-key palette with sharp typographic elements integrated into the sky.
coreVisualRelationships: The voluminous black fabric of the gown creates a heavy visual base against the light sand.
The trio forms a triangular cluster in the center-right, balanced by the negative space of the sky.
The sharp, thin serifs of the display text mirror the verticality of the beach grass.
coreInvariants: Desaturated earth tones mixed with deep blacks
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the scale of the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centrally located, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame; the female figure is scaled larger due to the gown's volume.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The deep black mass of the gown in the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large display text in the sky, moves down to the female subject's face, then follows the line of the gown to the two male figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the frame is a vast, pale sky providing a clean canvas for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale beige and off-white (sand and sky) providing a neutral backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black (clothing) creating a strong silhouette.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and subtle copper highlights in the dress fabric.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with extreme value contrast between the black clothing and the white sky.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to muted earth tones and monochrome

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Custom interlocking or overlapping of characters in the primary display line
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' and 'Y' in the top line are extended to frame the word
Curved baseline for the secondary display line to create a 'smile' arc

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the negative space of the sky

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast dramatic serif paired with a soft, approachable lowercase sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Curved baseline for the second word of the display text

avoid: Script fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high contrast and elegant verticality.
For the lowercase subtitle to provide a modern, soft contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photograph of three people (one woman in a large black ballgown, two men in black suits and white shirts) standing on a sandy beach dune with sparse dry grass under a bright, hazy white sky. Desaturated colors.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a stacked, high-contrast serif font in black at the top center. The second line of the title should have a slight upward arch. Add a smaller subtitle in lowercase sans-serif below and to the right of the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the sky bright enough to make the black text legible?
Does the gown occupy a significant portion of the lower frame?
Are the serifs on the main title sharp and thin?

adjustableVariables: Degree of arch in the typography baseline
Level of desaturation in the landscape

mustAchieve: Clean separation between subjects and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the black clothing against the light sand.
Ensure the text does not touch the subjects' heads.
Verify the horizon line is low in the frame.
Confirm the high-contrast serif maintains legibility in its thin strokes.
recipe.reuseFormula: Trio portrait + coastal dune + high-contrast serif typography + desaturated high-key palette.
